elements.label: Figure 2.1
elements.title: Periodic population surveys such as censuses help governments plan resources to supply public services.
elements.details: Photo showing people working at a Census 2010 booth or station, with visible signage 'Census 2010' and individuals engaged in census-related activities.
elements.summary: This image illustrates the practical aspect of population surveys like censuses, emphasizing their role in helping governments plan resource allocation for public services.
